notes.title: UPDATE: v1.2.1: Small fix to fix confusion between Demo and Full-Version
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know that a new update for Tyd wag vir Niemand has just been released that fixes a conflict between the Demo and Full-Version of the game.

One thing to take note is that your Save Progress will be gone, however it is not lost, you can copy it back from the Tyd wag vir Niemand-Demo save folder, here are the file paths for Windows, Mac and Linux to rectify your old Save Data:

Windows: C:\Users\[Your UserName]\AppData\LocalLow\Skobbejak Games\

Mac: ~/Library/Caches/ -OR- ~/Library/Application Support

Linux: $XDG_DATA_HOME/unity3d/ -OR- $HOME/.local/share/unity3d/

Sorry for the inconvenience, we hope that the change isnt too much of a hassle.

notes.title: UPDATE: v1.2: Some bug fixes, in-game Graphics Menu added.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for Tyd wag vir Niemand is now available and it fixes some bugs and also adds an in-game Graphics Menu.

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, it helps us immensely to find and squash any bugs that pop up, we truly appreciate the help and understanding :)

You can find a detailed rundown of the update below as well as our plans for the next update.

Fixes:

- Some fixes regarding Input
- Fix for initial continue load, the last played level will now load automatically without needing to select it.
- Some loading fixes were implemented.
- Some smaller additional fixes.

Additions:

-An in-game Graphics/Resolution menu has been added.

Possible Issues:

- Some sounds tweaks
- Some graphical tweaks
- Linux distros that arent officially supported might still have input/menu issues

Next Update:

- VR support for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive.
- Audio Menu
- Any necessary fixes
- Some tweaks and refinements

notes.title: UPDATE: v1.1: Some small bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for Tyd wag vir Niemand is now available and fixes so small issues, including loading bugs that occurred in some levels as well as an explicit 32-bit only version to ensure that all the 32-bit users can enjoy the game as well, you need to delete the game first and then re-download and install it if you are on a 32-bit system.

We also fixed an issue with the final Achievement however you will need to replay the levels that you have already played, apologies for the hassle. 

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, we truly appreciate it and we wouldn't be able to polish and refine Tyd wag vir Niemand without your feedback.

Below is a full rundown of the update as well as what is planned for the next update.

v1.1:

Fixes:

- Loading bugs that were present in some levels have been fixed.
- Final Achievement can now be unlocked (apologies you will need to replay the levels that you have played prior to this update)
- Explicit 32-bit only version of the game added for PC, Mac and Linux to ensure that all 32-bit users can play. 

Possible Issues:

- Some sounds tweaks
- Some graphical tweaks
- Menu doesn't go away completely when pressing the Menu button on any menu other than the Main Menu
- OSX Sierra may still have some input/menu issues.
- Linux distros that aren't officially supported might still have input/menu issues

Next Update:

- In-Game Graphics and Resolution Menu
- Audio Menu
- Any necessary fixes
- Some tweaks and refinements

notes.title: UPDATE: v1.0: FULL RELEASE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to let you all know that Tyd wag vir Niemand is now fully released!

We have added the last batch of levels as well as the storyline, along with a lot of fixes
and tweaks.

Please keep in mind that we are a very small indie studio and we do not have 100s of different PCs to run and test the game on, this is why we have chosen to go the Early Access path at first, although this does not guarantee that we have found and fixed all the issues. If yo do encounter any issues please let us know via email or on the Discussions Board so that we can get to it ASAP.

We arent done refining Tyd wag vir Niemand either, the next update will include some refinements and tweaks as well as an in-game Graphics and Resolution Menu. We are also looking to bringing VR support in a later update as well.

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, we truly appreciate it and we couldnt have made this game without your input :)

We hope you enjoy the game and please be sure to let us know what you think.

Stay tuned for the next update. 

Below is a rundown of whats been added to the current update along with Known Issues:

v1.0:

-2 New Levels and a Secret Level have been added
-Storyline has been added
-A lot of fixes, tweaks and refinements

Known Issues:

- Some sounds tweaks
- Some graphical tweaks
- Menu doesnt go away completely when pressing the Menu button on any menu other than the Main Menu

Next Update:

-In-Game Graphics and Resolution Menu
-Any necessary fixes
-Some tweaks and refinements

notes.title: Big update coming very soon. Final Release date set for July 7. Small Hotfix for Level 7.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to let you all know that we have a Big update coming that will add the final 3 levels for the game as well as the story and Achievements. Please keep in mind this update will likely erase your previous save game data as it might be integral to the story and progression, we apologize for any inconvenience if this is indeed the case.

Additionally we have set the Final Release date for July 7, but we want to have the update out a bit before then so that everyone can test it out and we can ensure we have all the last little wrinkles ironed out.

Also take note that we just uploaded a little hotfix for the number 3 digit in the 7th level that caused some glitches when saving the level and re-entering the game. Everything should work fine now.

Thanks again for all the feedback and support everyone we cant thank you enough :)

Please let us know if you run into any other issues so that we can ensure they are fixed before Final Release.

Stay tuned for the Big update before Final Release coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE: v0.6: Level load glitch fixed. New Save Structure and Control Mapper.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for Tyd wag vir Niemand (v0.6) is now available. 

This update fixes the glitch that prevented the levels after the Ship Level from loading, apologies for the inconvenience and thanks for the heads up everyone. 

We also included a new, improved Saving Structure so that you can carry on exactly where you left off when exiting and restarting the game.

Finally, we also added Control Mapping options so that you can set your own controls as well as sensitivity and invert look.

Below is a rundown of the entire update.

Please keep in mind that the next update might take a while as we want to start working in the story and we dont want to spoil all the levels before the story gets integrated. We have some awesome stuff planned for the story so we want to take our time and make sure we get everything just right.

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, we hope you enjoy the new update.

v0.6:

Additions:

-New Saving Structure
-Control Mapper Options have been added

Fixes:

-Glitch that prevented the following level after the Ship Level from loading has been fixed

Next Update:

-Another batch of new levels
-Story Integration

notes.title: UPDATE: v0.5: 3 New Levels, Sprinting feature and some fixes.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know v0.5 is now available and includes 3 New Levels as well as a sprinting feature that allows the player to move faster but is only usable in normal speed as to not hamper the time-based challenges. 

We have also worked in a fix for the fireballs getting stuck on the 4th level and we have also adjusted the landing of the player when jumping to not kneel the player down as severely.

The next update will include another batch of levels as well as add a more specific saving structure that allows the player to continue from the last checkpoint that they left off instead of just the level.

Please find below a breakdown of the update.

Thanks again for all the support so far everyone, we hope you enjoy the latest update and please let us know if you run into any issues or have any suggestions. Stay tuned for the next update coming soon :)

v0.5:

Additions:

-3 New Levels added
-Sprinting feature added

Fixes:

-Fireball glitch in Level 4 has been fixed
-Kneeling of player has been adjusted when landing from a jump to not be as sever and jarring.

Next Update:

-Another batch of new levels
-More advanced and convenient saving structure

notes.title: UPDATE: v0.2 Now available, New Level Added.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First of all, thanks so much for all the support with the Early Access release, we're very glad you're all enjoying Tyd wag vir Niemand so far, we're really having a lot of fun with development and were happy that we can share in the fun with our players.

We wanted to let you all know that v0.2 has been released and it includes a New Level. We hope you all enjoy it and please let us know what you think.

Stay tuned as the next update will include another level as well as a sprinting feature that wont hamper the challenge of the game. Thanks goes out to Deviation and Drewid for their feedback on this issue, we really appreciate the constructive criticism as it helps us iron out all of the issues present so that we can ensure Tyd wag vir Niemand is polished and refined as much as possible.

We are also looking into working in a story the best way we can, we had an initial idea for a story but we wanted our focus to concentrate on the gameplay and environment first and get it refined and polished but also get the opinion of everyone on the importance of a story, we will be working out a story as we develop the levels and then add it once we feel it is refined in enough to start adding it in.

Thanks again for all the support everyone, we hope you enjoy the new level, looking forward to your feedback and stay tuned as more updates and levels are coming soon :)

v0.2:

New Addtions:

-New Level Added.  


Things to be added in the Next UPDATE:

New Additions:

-Sprint feature
-Another Level
